info.name: 24/7HR – PHED Payroll Module
info.description:
24/7HR – PHED Payroll Module

Complete API reference for the PHED payroll module. All endpoints require a Bearer JWT token in the Authorization header except where noted.

## Rate Limiting

Every endpoint is rate-limited by IP address. Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header (seconds to wait) and X-RateLimit-* headers.

| Profile | Limit | Window | Endpoints |
|---|---|---|---|
| auth | 10 req | 60 s | Login, Change Password |
| compute | 5 req | 15 min | Compute Payroll |
| upload | 15 req | 5 min | All file uploads |
| report | 40 req | 60 s | Reports, payslip PDFs, templates |
| write | 60 req | 60 s | POST / PUT / DELETE mutations |
| read | 150 req | 60 s | GET list / detail endpoints |

429 response body:
{"success": false, "message": "Too many requests. Please slow down and try again shortly.", "data": null}

## Collection Variables

Set these in your environment:
- baseUrl — https://hrms.isurfglobal.com
- token — JWT from Login
- companyId — PHED company UUID
- periodId — Pay period UUID
- staffId — phed_staff UUID
- gradeId — Grade UUID
- unionId — Union UUID
- coopId — Cooperative UUID

request.description:
Authenticate and receive a JWT token. Include the token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on all subsequent requests.

**Rate limit:** 10 requests / 60 seconds per IP.

If `requirePasswordChange` is `true` in the response, redirect the user to change their password before allowing access to any other page.

Response includes `company` object (name, email, phone, address).

response.name: 200 OK – Login successful
429 – Rate limit exceeded

request.description:
Change the authenticated user's password. Required on first login when `requirePasswordChange` is true.

**Rate limit:** 10 requests / 60 seconds per IP.

- `currentPassword`: the current (or temporary) password
- `newPassword`: minimum 8 characters

On success, `requirePasswordChange` is cleared server-side.

item.name: Configuration – Grades
item.description: Salary grades define the pay structure for each employee category. Each grade has a name, code, and a set of allowance templates.

request.description: Returns the allowance breakdown for a grade. Each template specifies a component type (HOUSING, TRANSPORT, etc.), whether the value is FIXED (₦) or PERCENTAGE (% of basic), and the amount.

body.description: Upserts all templates at once. allowanceType values: HOUSING | TRANSPORT | FURNITURE | MEAL_SUBSIDY | UTILITY | LEAVE | SHIFT | OTHER. valueType: FIXED | PERCENTAGE.

request.description: monthlyAmount is a fixed naira deduction per month per member.
deductionPercentage is applied to gross salary. e.g. 5 = 5% of gross.

**Rate limit:** 40 requests / 60 seconds per IP.

request.description:
Assign a single union to a staff member. Call once per union.

This is an **incremental** operation — it adds the union without removing any existing ones.

To remove a union, send DELETE to the same URL with `{ "unionId": "uuid" }`.

Assign a single cooperative to a staff member. Call once per cooperative.

This is an **incremental** operation — adds the cooperative without removing existing ones.

To remove, send DELETE to the same URL with `{ "cooperativeId": "uuid" }`.

**Rate limit:** 15 requests / 5 minutes per IP.

Upserts staff records from file. Rows with matching staffId+companyId are updated; new rows are created. Login accounts are provisioned and welcome emails sent for newly created staff only.

request.description: **Rate limit:** 15 requests / 5 minutes per IP.

**Rate limit:** 40 requests / 60 seconds per IP.

Downloads .xlsx pre-populated with all active staff. Only the Overtime Hours column needs to be filled.

Runs the full payroll engine for all active staff in the period. Period must be in VALIDATION_CLOSED or REVIEW status. Can be re-run to correct errors.

**Rate limit:** 5 requests / 15 minutes per IP (expensive operation).

What is computed:
- Salary components (basic + allowances from grade template or staff overrides)
- Overtime: (Monthly Gross / 160) × 1.5 × OT hours
- Gross salary
- Pension: 8% EE / 10% ER on (basic + housing + transport)
- NHF: 2.5% of basic
- PAYE: NTA 2025 progressive bands after pension and rent relief
- Union deductions (fixed naira amounts)
- Cooperative deductions (% of gross)
- Net salary = Gross - Total Deductions
- Withheld reason is captured for staff marked NO_FOR_PAYMENT

Status advances to REVIEW.
Approves the payroll. Period must be in REVIEW status. Restricted to ADMIN and SUPER_ADMIN roles.
Sends HTML payslip emails to all ACTIVE staff. Period transitions to PAID. Can be called again on PAID periods to resend.

**Rate limit:** 40 requests / 60 seconds per IP.

Downloads a PDF payslip for a specific staff member. staffId here is the phed_staff.id UUID. Period must be APPROVED or PAID.
